description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist
